cases.name: before side effect
cases.initial_state: valid claimed task with active lease
cases.final_consistency_condition: after lease expiry recover() may requeue once; no completed record before successful retry

cases.name: after side effect before outbox
cases.final_consistency_condition: recovery must detect prior side effect or use idempotency key before retry

cases.name: after outbox before registry
cases.initial_state: active claim with valid result payload
cases.final_consistency_condition: recovery reconciles outbox into exactly one completed record without rewriting outbox hash

cases.name: after registry before running cleanup
cases.final_consistency_condition: restart removes stale running artifact and preserves exactly one completed record/outbox

cases.name: during checkpoint update
cases.final_consistency_condition: canonical checkpoint is either old or new valid JSON; never partial

cases.name: during lease recovery
expected_files: at most one active generation 2 claim
cases.final_consistency_condition: restart converges to generation 2 owner; generation 1 fenced

cases.name: stale owner submission
cases.initial_state: claim A generation 1 expired; claim B generation 2 active
cases.final_consistency_condition: A submit rejected; only B can commit

cases.name: duplicate restart
cases.initial_state: completed task with stable outbox and registry
cases.final_consistency_condition: outbox hash and registry bytes unchanged across restart
